title: Rings Around the Ancilla: A Workload-Aware FTQC Architecture
summary: Obtaining a quantum advantage in practical applications over classical machines requires a fault-tolerant model of computation. However, the resource overhead of developing a fault-tolerant quantum computer (FTQC) architecture is quite high. Current state-of-the-art architecture designs promise constant-time access to logical qubits at the expense of a high qubit overhead, or qubit-dense layouts at the expense of increased latency in the execution of a quantum workload.
